resources.string: Minecraft\'s clock item, on your home screen.
The time on Minecraft\'s clock item.
This launcher can\'t add widgets from an app. Long-press your home screen and pick Minecraft Clock from the widgets list.

The dial is Minecraft\'s clock item: 64 frames, chosen from the world time with the same maths the game uses. Sunrise (tick 0) lines up with 06:00 on this device, so the sun sits at the top of the dial at noon and the moon at midnight.
